content:
A new local business, Legacy Resale and Organization, is now open. Owned by Chelsie Benavides, the business helps people sell and organize the items they no longer need, with a personal touch.

Legacy Resale and Organization works on a quote-only basis, with no prices listed. Written authorization is required before any item is sold.

To get started, text Chelsie first at (512) 801-6657 and leave a message, or email legacyresaleorg@outlook.com. For more information, visit legacyresaleorg.com.

Sources: Legacy Resale and Organization.
